fields.statement: At 8f4eb820, read the diff of internal/api/run_milestone.go: the check reads .rhiza/policy.toml, requires the run's started milestone (RHIZA_MILESTONE) when set, requires some milestone only when backlog = "skip", and otherwise passes, with errors naming the change set and a Fix. Ran go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestRunMilestoneCheck from a scratch worktree outside ~/code: TestRunMilestoneCheck (backlog = skip: serving nothing or a loose intent fails naming the change set; serving a milestone directly or through an intent passes) and TestRunMilestoneCheckBacklogAndNamedMilestone (no policy and backlog = before pass; with a milestone, serving it directly or through an intent passes; serving another milestone or none fails naming the change set and milestone) both PASS. Ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts for plan-milestone-backlog (fake agent, change set serves an intent under no milestone, no policy.toml: milestone-check passes and the run enters review), plan-milestone-check (same with backlog = skip: fails at milestone-check, never reviewed), plan-workflow and describe-golden: ok.
